name: Hayase Hiruno
source:
Age: unknown
Likes: freedom
Skill: abusive talk, harsh remarks, recklessness
Role: mysterious high school girl

A mysterious high school girl who appeared before Judgement 7 while they were lodging at Minamiboso. She picks fights with Judgement 7 by using abusive talk and harsh remarks. Self-centered, quick-tempered and irritable, this troublesome girl is hard to have a talk with.

[Translated from [url=http://oreowa.jp/character/hiruno.html]the official site[/url]]
